interpretation_boundary: Stage60 freezes a prospective PPARD application test of an unchanged, previously unsupported QUBO. It does not claim that the objective is effective, that exact QUBO beats strong classical optimization, or that quantum hardware has an advantage. Only the remaining development-train preparation and docking are authorized; fresh validation, locked test, and quantum hardware remain closed.

nested_cv.final_development_model_rule: After reporting nested outer-fold results, select the smallest k within one standard error of the highest mean outer-holdout robust BEDROC20 and refit once on all Train-240 rows.
nested_cv.inner_evaluation_metric: robust BEDROC20=(primary median-seed BEDROC20 + mean seed BEDROC20 + worst seed BEDROC20)/3
nested_cv.inner_training_action: Fit train-only empirical rank transforms and QUBO coefficients, then exactly optimize each fixed k.
nested_cv.k_selection_definition: Let k_star maximize mean inner-holdout robust BEDROC20. Compute the sample standard error at k_star across the three inner folds. Select the smallest k whose mean is at least mean(k_star)-SE(k_star). Break numerical ties by smaller k.
nested_cv.outer_evaluation_action: Refit coefficients and exact fixed-k QUBO on the complete outer-train partition at the inner-selected k, then evaluate the untouched outer holdout.
nested_cv.reason_no_literal_early_docking_stop: All k values reuse one receptor-by-ligand score matrix; increasing k does not launch additional docking jobs. The stopping rule controls model complexity, not docking execution.

transferred_objective.fixed_k_qubo: Q_k(S)=mean_{i in S}(q_i)+mean_{i<j in S}(delta_ij); for k=1 the pair term is zero
transferred_objective.normalization_reason: separate normalization at each fixed k removes the Stage42d cardinality pressure and implements the previously proposed k=1..6 ladder
transferred_objective.pair_complementarity: delta_ij=q_{ij}-max(q_i,q_j), where q_{ij} uses the better rank from receptor i or j
transferred_objective.qubo_form: For each frozen k, maximize sum_i(q_i/k)x_i + sum_{i<j}(delta_ij/C(k,2))x_i x_j subject to sum_i x_i=k.
transferred_objective.rank_normalization: per-seed per-receptor empirical CDF fitted on outer-train rows only
